newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-FEMALE PUNTER PUTS FAITH IN ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FEMALE PUNTER PUTS FAITH IN ENGLAND.

text.p: An English woman has placed a bet of 18,500 pounds ($29,600) at odds of 1/6 on England beating Scotland in Saturday's Five Nations game at Twickenham.

The female punter, from Essex, will make a profit of 1,300 pounds ($2,000) if things go according to plan. "It's a very bold wager considering England's recent form," said William Hill spokesman Graham Sharpe.
